reason: The lab report per batch is what I actually look for, so that part is good. But $25 to $30 a month is a lot on my budget for one form of magnesium, when a bottle of bisglycinate at the store costs less and lasts longer.
objection: Why pay about $30 a month for a single form of magnesium when other products put several forms in one capsule for less? I can't tell what the sachet is giving me that a cheap bottle isn't.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 for 30 days, or a first batch lab report I can open and read that shows the real magnesium amount per capsule.
